sources.title: GitHub - skykim/siglip2-unity: SigLIP2 model in Unity Sentis
sources.snippet: This repository provides a lightweight inference implementation optimized for SigLIP2 (specifically siglip2-base-patch16-224) using Unity Sentis. This project enables powerful multi-modal retrieval tasks directly within Unity, allowing for smart asset search and semantic retrieval across text and images without requiring an internet connection.
